subject: Re: Separate VLA Project
text:
Hi Winnie,

Thanks for sending over the referral agreement. Took a read through and
it's in good shape overall - just three small changes I'd like to land
before we sign:

1. Section 8 - can we add a quick deal registration mechanic so attribution
is clean? Something like: "A Party shall be considered directly responsible
for procuring a customer if it notifies the other Party in writing of the
introduction and the other Party confirms in writing within 10 business
days." Saves us both a headache the first time it matters.

2. Section 8 - can we also exclude existing customers of either party who
are simply migrating their labeling work to the other party from a
different vendor? The current carve-out covers existing customers and
recent solicitations, but doesn't cover the case where, say, one of our
existing customers decides to move their labeling spend over to Encord (or
vice versa). Suggested language: "For the avoidance of doubt, no
compensation shall be payable in respect of any customer that, at the time
of the referral, is an existing customer of the receiving Party in any
capacity, including customers transitioning services from a third party
vendor."

3. Section 4(d) - the survival clause looks like it got cut off
mid-sentence ("Termination`Section 4..."). Can you have your team clean
that up so it clearly lists which sections survive termination? I think
this text just needs to be deleted "Termination`Section 4 (Warranties and
Disclaimers), 5 (Term and Termination), 6 (Relationship of the
Parties), 7 (Intellectual Property Rights), 8 (Confidentiality of
Proprietary Information), and 10
(General Provisions)."

Happy to jump on a quick call if easier, but these all feel like clean
edits on your end. Let me know and, if agreeable, please then send to me
for esignature (Evan McElwain, evan.mcelwain@execo.com).

Thanks,
Evan

subject: Re: Beetroot | Encord
text:
Hi Winnie,

Our legal team has reviewed the mNDA and is comfortable with the document
overall. We have a few targeted proposed changes below, mostly standard for
a cross-border mutual NDA of this kind. I'd appreciate it if you could
route these to your legal team for sign-off, after which we'll execute
promptly on our side.

1. Section 2(c)
We propose changing "best efforts" to "reasonable efforts" in the sentence:
"Recipient will provide Discloser prompt written notice, if legally
permissible, and will use its reasonable efforts to assist Discloser in
seeking a protective order or another appropriate remedy." "Best efforts"
is an unusually high contractual standard whereas "reasonable efforts" is
the typical formulation for NDAs and is what our standard playbook uses.

2. Section 3
We propose adding "independent contractors" to the list, so the definition
reads: "Recipient's employees, independent contractors, agents, officers,
advisers and representatives and those of its affiliates (the
'Representatives')." This reflects how our delivery model works, as we
engage specialists on contractor terms in some geographies, and they need
to be covered under the same confidentiality obligations as employees.

3. Section 9
We suggest replacing the existing paragraph in full with the following, so
that export-controlled information is flagged in advance and the receiving
party has the option to refuse before being put under export-control
obligations:

"Before disclosing any software and other technical information which the
Discloser believes may be subject to restrictions and controls imposed by
the Export Administration Act, Export Administration Regulations and other
laws and regulations of the United States and any other applicable
government or jurisdiction, as enacted from time to time (the 'Acts'), the
Discloser shall inform the Recipient and give the Recipient an opportunity
to refuse the disclosure. If the Recipient accepts the disclosure, the
Parties shall comply
